source.title: Polatuzumab Vedotin in Previously Untreated Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma

duplicate_review.finding: No duplicate atoms detected by deterministic extraction key; repeated outcome evidence was retained only when it represented distinct source assertions or source locations.

consistency_findings.finding: Table 2 visually labels Pola-R-CHP N=439 and R-CHOP N=440, while randomization text, Table 1, Figure 2, and outcome percentages correspond to Pola-R-CHP n=440 and R-CHOP n=439. This apparent source-level column-header transposition was not silently corrected inside table-anchored source text.

extraction_limitations: The retrieved package did not include the full trial protocol or statistical analysis plan referenced by the article; protocol-only details were not invented.
Conflict-of-interest disclosures were not present in the retrieved main article or supplemental-information PDF; no conflict_of_interest atom was fabricated.
Exploratory subgroup estimates were extracted from Supplementary Figure S1 and should not be interpreted as powered subgroup comparisons.
Supplement pages 1-15 are investigator listings and were treated as provenance/administrative material rather than evidence assertions.
schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated trial-registration or sponsor-role object; these are represented using tags and existing atom kinds.
The quantitative result model is optimized for one normalized estimate per atom; arm-specific milestone rates are preserved in arms and canonical statements alongside hazard ratios.

batch_manifest.scope: Main article introduction and methods, pages 3-6
Main article results, discussion, figures and tables, pages 7-19
Supplementary methods and recruitment discussion, pages 16-26
